intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Henderson for 2026, and here is what he found: 18 family events, 10 of them free. The magic runs from November 5 (33rd Annual Holiday Cactus Garden Lights at Ethel M Chocolates) through January 3, with Santa Photos and Visits at Galleria at Sunset (from November 21), The Great Migratory Elf Hunt at Henderson Bird Viewing Preserve (from November 28), WinterFest 2026 (from December 3) and Jingle Jam at Anthem Community Church (December 11) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Henderson

  • 18 Christmas events for kids in Henderson
  • 10 free events, including Jingle Jam at Anthem Community Church, Santa at The Village at Lake Las Vegas and the library gingerbread house sessions
  • Meet Santa: Pictures with Santa at Black Mountain Recreation Center (December 5), Breakfast with Santa at Dave and Buster's (December 6), Santa at The Village at Lake Las Vegas (December 12) and Santa Photos and Visits at Galleria at Sunset
  • Parades and tree lightings: WinterFest 2026 tree lighting and Electric Light Parade (December 3 and 4)
  • Also new: The Great Migratory Elf Hunt scavenger hunt (November 28 to December 23)
  • Season: November 5 to January 3

Planning a bigger day out? Henderson families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Las Vegas, which covers Enchant Las Vegas, the Magical Forest at Opportunity Village and the Downtown Summerlin Holiday Parade.
